description: This file defines the EmployeeSalary entity class for the OrangeHRM project. It maps to the database table 'hs_hr_emp_basicsalary' and uses Doctrine ORM annotations to specify entity relationships and columns. The class encapsulates properties related to employee salary data, including associations with employee, pay grade, currency type, pay period, direct debit, and other salary details, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmployeeSalary
classes.description: Entity class representing employee salary details within the OrangeHRM system, including relationships to employee, pay grade, currency, pay period, and direct debit information, with ORM annotations for database mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the employee salary record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the employee salary record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee entity associated with this salary record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this salary record.

methods.name: getPayGrade
methods.description: Retrieves the PayGrade associated with this salary.

methods.name: setPayGrade
methods.description: Associates a PayGrade with this salary.

methods.name: getCurrencyType
methods.description: Retrieves the CurrencyType entity for this salary.

methods.name: setCurrencyType
methods.description: Sets the CurrencyType for this salary.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Gets the amount for the salary, stored as a string.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount for the salary.

methods.name: getPayPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the PayPeriod associated with this salary.

methods.name: setPayPeriod
methods.description: Associates a PayPeriod with this salary.

methods.name: getSalaryName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the salary component.

methods.name: setSalaryName
methods.description: Sets the name of the salary component.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves comments associated with this salary.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets comments related to this salary.

methods.name: getDirectDebit
methods.description: Returns the EmpDirectDebit entity linked to this salary.

methods.name: setDirectDebit
methods.description: Associates an EmpDirectDebit entity with this salary.
